lines: Muddat hui hai yaar ko mehmaan kiye hue
couplets.en: It has been so long since my beloved was my guest.

lines: Muddat hui hai yaar ko mehmaan kiye hue
couplets.en: It has been so long since my beloved was my guest.

lines: Karta hoon jam'a phir jigar-e-lakht lakht ko
couplets.en: Once again I gather the pieces of my heart.

lines: Arsa hua hai dawat-e-mizhgaan kiye hue
couplets.en: It has been long since I laid a feast for those lashes.

lines: Phir pursish-e-jaraahat-e-dil ko chala hai ishq
couplets.en: Love has set out again to ask after the wounded heart.
It comes with a hundred thousand vessels of salt.

lines: Daude hai phir har ek gul-o-laala par khayaal
couplets.en: My thoughts run again to every rose and tulip.

lines: Sad gulistaan nigaah ka samaan kiye hue
couplets.en: My gaze has a hundred gardens ready.

lines: Chaahe hai phir kisi ko muqaabil mein aarzoo
couplets.en: Longing would have that one face me again.

lines: Surme se tez dashna-e-mizhgaan kiye hue
couplets.en: Kohl has whetted the dagger of those lashes.
My head bows under the weight of pleading with the gatekeeper.

lines: Dil phir tawaaf-e-koo-e-malaamat ko jaaye hai
couplets.en: The heart goes round the lane of reproach once more.

lines: Pindaar ka sanam-kada veeraan kiye hue
couplets.en: The shrine of my pride lies desolate.

lines: Baithe hain hum tahayya-e-toofaan kiye hue
couplets.en: Here I sit, with a storm ready to break.
